description: Minimum test count per tier. A suite that shrinks without explanation is a silently disabled suite — a broken include glob drops the unit tier from 1024 tests to 3 and every other gate still passes, because total > 0, failed === 0 and success === true.
howToRaise: Raise a floor in the same commit that adds the tests. Lowering one is also a reviewable diff — state why in the commit message.
establishedBy: PR CI run 19 (run id 30431556718), artifacts `evidence-unit-coverage` / `evidence-security-matrix` / `evidence-integration-tests`, files `test-totals-unit.json`, `test-totals-database.json`, `test-totals-backend.json`, at feature head 8d7bfff09cf914e00ff5ff4587341ece261185c3, started 2026-07-29T07:24:48Z, GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest. All three tiers now carry a hosted measurement; none is a local or carried-over figure.
enforcementNote: Only `minTests` is enforced — summarise-vitest.mjs fails a tier that runs fewer. `measured` is provenance: it records what the named run actually observed, so a later reader can see how much headroom a floor had when it was set.

unit.note: Raised from 1000 to 1050. Run 19 measured 1082 on a hosted runner, replacing the local 1024 that established the old floor. The floor keeps roughly 30 tests of headroom for ordinary churn while no longer sitting 82 below the real count, where it could have absorbed an entire deleted test file without complaint.

That run set the original floor of 1180. RAISED across this remediation to 1509, then 1433, then 1473 during the canonical-blocker remediation on the same PR, which added the executed-write suite, the route permission-binding suite, the profile accessibility suite, the plate-section suite and the corrected API-contract cases, taking the tier to 70 files and 1586 executed cases (the defect wave that followed added the 422 field-error path, the CSP sink cases and the const-arrow completeness cases). The raise was forced rather than chosen: 1180 sat BELOW the 1264 cases the tree now declares on disk, and a floor beneath cases that physically exist is not a guard. See measurementProvenance: the LOCAL figure that stood in `measured` HAS NOW BEEN REPLACED by the hosted measurement P1-27-QA-005 took, which is 1867. This sentence used to read "the 1467 is a LOCAL figure and is replaced by the hosted measurement P1-27-QA-005 takes against the final candidate" — future tense for something that has happened, and 1467 is a number measurementProvenance contradicts (it records the superseded local figure as 1586). The bare 1467 is dropped rather than corrected, because no record in this repository establishes that it was ever the value of this field.
web.whatTheHeadroomGuarantees: THE FLOOR DETECTS ANY NET LOSS OF MORE THAN 74 EXECUTED TESTS. That is measured (1867) minus the floor (1793), stated as the bound it actually is. The largest web test file declares 75 cases (api-client.test.ts), so the headroom sits just below it and deleting that file trips the floor. Both tensions are satisfied: headroom above 0 so the floor is not a transcript of its own run, and below the largest file so the deletion guarantee holds. Raised from 1509 when QA-005 replaced the local measurement of 1586 with the hosted 1867 — the floor moves with a HOSTED measurement of the closing candidate, never with a local one.
web.measuredFilesNote: `measuredFiles` is 70 — physical test files, matching the tier. web.measurementProvenance: HOSTED, and binding. ESTABLISHED at 424e5d884ed7c8f608c446408743cbf88ac80515 by GitHub-hosted run 31508526699, job 93836261711 (`Web quality / web-quality`), which reported `Tests executed | 1867`: 70 files, 1867 executed, 0 failed, 0 skipped, 0 todo. That second run is why 424e5d8 is described here as the head the figure was established at and NOT as the final candidate: this field called it "the final candidate" while the branch went on to take three more commits, so the sentence beside a correct number was a claim about the repository that had quietly stopped being true — the exact defect QA-005 exists to catch, in the field that records how the number was caught. The VALUE did not move and must not be re-measured downwards: 1867 is what both hosted runs reported and what a local run of this tree reports. This REPLACES the local 1586 that stood here while the branch was still being assembled — that number was 281 tests below the tree and was stated in the present tense on clean-room-evidence.md. It was found by measuring the tier, not by any gate: both gates compared the document to THIS field and never to the tree, so the record and the baseline agreed with each other while both disagreed with the repository.

unitFloorCaveat: The unit floor is deliberately NOT set to the measurement of the run that carries this commit. This change adds twenty tests — eight in tests/ci/dependency-path-proof.test.ts (AR-49), four in the workflow-security rule-registry suite (AR-50), four in tests/ci/baseline-integrity.test.ts covering the baselines established here, and four in tests/ci/documented-counts.test.ts (AR-51) — so the final head measures 1102, not the 1082 recorded above. Setting 1102 as the floor would make it a transcript of the last run rather than a guard, and every future commit would have to move it. 1050 is the guard; 1082 stays as the provenance of run 19. Note that this sentence is itself the kind of hand-written count AR-51 was about, which is why the floor and the provenance figure — the two values anything actually reads — are measured rather than narrated.
